statusPolicy.FULL: All declared behavior has automated positive and negative evidence.
statusPolicy.PARTIAL: A local mapping exists, but one or more declared behaviors lack implementation or automated evidence.
statusPolicy.MISSING: The required observable behavior is not implemented and evidenced locally.

contracts.requirement: Activate for branch or pull-request preparation and require an approved linked issue.
Bind remote reads and writes to an explicitly authorized target, operation, and credential session; keep delivery separately authorized.
Require target policy, one valid type label, branch and commit naming, template evidence, and required checks before merge-ready claims.
Return target, issue linkage, branch and pull-request state, labels, checks, tests, and pending authority.
Do not infer a default branch, probe ambient credentials, invent green checks, or commit, push, open, label, or merge without specific authorization.
Activate for an over-budget or explicitly requested chained or stacked review slice.
Use one honest slicing pass, a 400 authored-line and roughly 60-minute review budget, cohesive work units, and explicit dependencies.
Choose single, independent stack, dependent feature chain, or documented exception from landing and rollback constraints.
Return strategy, ordered slices, bases, dependency diagram, changed-line budget, verification, rollback, and exception rationale.
Do not code-golf, omit evidence, mix strategies, assume the default branch, or tolerate polluted child diffs.
Activate for human-facing technical, review, architecture, onboarding, and contributor documentation.
Lead with the outcome, disclose detail progressively, chunk content, signpost location, and prefer recognition over recall.
Use an explicit quick path, details, checklist, next step, review order, and out-of-scope statement when applicable.
Return a scannable document with validated claims, clear reader action, review path, and unresolved risks.
Do not bury decisions in background, force recall, or leave reviewers to reconstruct scope and verification.
Activate whenever writing a repository or asynchronous collaboration comment for another human.
Lead with the actionable point, remain warm and direct, explain why, match context language, and prefer one to three short paragraphs.
Prioritize the highest-value issue and distinguish required correction, suggestion, approval, and bounded question.
Return a concise collaboration message with concrete evidence and next action when needed.
Do not pile on minor preferences, sound automated, attribute blame, claim unheld authority, or use em dashes.
Activate the harness for non-trivial, risky, multi-step, or routing-sensitive work.
Derive scope, uncertainty, risk, review workload, test applicability, and routing from evidence while keeping one responsible parent.
Select direct, delegated exploration, bounded implementation, or verification routes using mandatory complexity triggers.
Return route, risk, tracking and isolation state, test evidence or exception, selected skills, and unresolved decisions.
Do not invent test evidence, bypass routing triggers, allow concurrent overlapping writes, or claim memory or review authority from prose.
Activate for issue creation, triage, bug reports, feature requests, and approval preparation.
Discover authorized target policy and forms, search duplicates, preserve form order, privacy-scan exact content, and bind each mutation to authority.
Fail closed on ambiguous targets, forms, required answers, protected labels, permissions, duplicate saturation, or uncertain publication.
Return target, selected form, reviewed body and labels, duplicate evidence, publication readback, and confirmed, no-write, or unknown outcome.
Do not probe credentials, invent answers or labels, blanket-check declarations, retry uncertain writes, leak private data, or infer later-action authority.
Activate only on an explicit dual or adversarial review request and one exact frozen target.
Run exactly two blind read-only judges, freeze canonical rows, permit at most two scoped fix and re-judgment rounds, and run one final verification.
Fix only surviving severe frozen IDs, treat warnings as informational, and escalate round-two survivors or malformed evidence.
Return target, frozen IDs and hash-bound rows, rounds used, final verification, skill resolution, and approved or escalated judgment.
Judges and fix agents must not mint authority, add findings during re-judgment, exceed sweep or round budgets, deliver, or consume ordinary review.
Activate for receipt-driven defect, review-authority, correction, recovery, delivery-gate, or bounded-review work.
Require approved issue, clean current-base reproduction, conflict audit, causal invariant, operator-flow inventory, candidate-bound evidence, and independent validation.
Stop or narrow on failed reproduction, split independent causes, select real journey evidence, and chain or obtain an exception above 400 authored lines.
Return mode, issue and pull-request authority, causal invariant, flows, runtime evidence, line budget, tests, rollback, and unresolved decisions.
Do not treat review evidence as delivery authority, use proxy coverage for another runtime, merge conflicting authority lines, or blame contributors.
Activate for creating or updating a reusable LLM runtime Skill, not one-off work or ordinary documentation.
Apply exact frontmatter, imperative runtime instructions, ordered sections, a 180 to 450 body-token target, 1000-token hard maximum, and local support files.
Choose an existing Skill, a new Skill, assets, or references according to reuse, duplication, and supporting-material needs.
Return changed files, new-versus-updated status, supporting files, registry impact, and verification needs.
Do not write tutorials, add keyword sections, use nonlocal references, duplicate behavior, or hide enforceable policy only in prose.
Activate for auditing, refactoring, normalizing, or improving existing Skill contracts.
Default to audit-only, preserve intent and activation, use the normative guide and project registry, and move rather than silently delete meaningful material.
Classify metadata, tutorial form, budget, hidden branching, and ambiguous-rule defects before any authorized correction.
Return audited paths, severity-grouped findings, applied changes, registry recommendation, and ambiguities for human review.
Do not modify in audit-only mode, invent triggers or policy, erase intent, or report FULL parity without behavioral automated evidence.
Activate after Skill installation, removal, creation, movement, or rename and before delegation requiring a fresh index.
Index exact Skill paths and trigger text from all known project and user sources, keep source contracts authoritative, cache deterministically, and persist when memory is available.
Prefer project scope, preserve first configured global source, skip excluded names, emit an empty registry, and invalidate stale cache deterministically.
Write .asen/skill-registry.md and return project, path, count, cache state, duplicates, skips, and persistence result.
Do not compile summaries in place of source contracts, guess missing Skills, use a different registry path, or retain stale entries after refresh.
Activate while planning implementation, commit boundaries, review slices, tests, docs, and rollback.
Keep one deliverable behavior, implementation, tests, docs, evidence, and rollback in one reviewable work unit with conventional history.
Split on independent behavior or rollback, monitor the 400-line budget, and apply the selected delivery strategy without code-golf.
Return purpose, scope, exact focused and runtime verification, rollback boundary, candidate identity, line count, and delivery-slice relationship.
Do not split by file type, separate tests or docs from behavior, invent command results, omit rollback, or treat a task checkbox as the review candidate.
